label.title: Reproductive and Gender-Affirming Health Care Access

claims.claim_text: Commitment to fight to protect and codify the right to reproductive freedom.
Support for reproductive justice for all.
Support for legislation to ban sex-selective abortions—gender discrimination in its most lethal form.
Commitment to always protect sexual and reproductive health and rights.
Commitment to defend all women's right to reproductive health care.
Support for guaranteed reproductive health care.
Commitment to continue to support efforts to protect women against pregnancy discrimination.
Support for vigorously opposing state and federal bans on gender-affirming health care.
Commitment to end health insurance discrimination against contraception.
Support for the Violence Against Women Act.
Support for repeal of the Hyde Amendment and all legal restrictions on abortion access.
Support for guaranteed gender-affirming health care.
